scope: Waypoint 1: add an isolated nimble-knots-artillery-v10-r8 state that wraps the accepted R7 combat authority with bounded objective objects, revision and hash metadata while standard Practice and PEI-gated Daily remain R7.

Expose coin and chest physics through a wallet-free private v10r8 preview with code-owned placeholder presentation for physical Phone Gate A.
